### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Strictly limit subjective entries to patient-reported symptoms and history; exclude all provider observations or physical exam findings.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Ensure all quantitative descriptors (e.g., '2+', specific measurements) are accurately reported and strictly associated with the exact finding they describe in the transcript; do not transfer or infer such details between different findings.
